spells.name: Fell Blades
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Nighthaunt Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Nighthaunt^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Wrench Souls
spells.effect: The target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Nighthaunt Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non-**^^Hero Nighthaunt Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Chains of Death
spells.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Nighthaunt Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **^^Hero^^** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
